'''Toxxun''' was the name of a massive [[narvaxx]] that was infected with the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] during a [[Rakghoul pandemic|resurgence]] of the plague on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It resided in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] until it was killed by individuals working for [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Toxxun appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as a World Boss during the Rakghoul Resurgence on Corellia, a recurring World Event.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''
